name: The Font
description: A source of Halo guarded by the Cabaretti and moved regularly.

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Jetmir plan the Crescendo and discuss the Adversary and the Font.
timeline.quote: "Besides, the moment the Font is revealed, everything in New Capenna will change and the Cabaretti will be on top."

pages_say.description: A secret source of Halo known only to the Cabaretti's inner council, to be revealed at the Crescendo.
A source of power belonging to the Cabaretti, which the Adversary considers ripe for taking.
The Cabaretti's rumored way to make unlimited Halo.
A source of Halo guarded by the Cabaretti and moved regularly.
